title: Baby's First Christmas and Holidays Memory Pages, Printable Baby Book Pages, First Holiday Keepsake, Letter and A4 PDF
description:
Your baby's first holidays, written down before they blur. Little Firsts: First Holidays is 10 printable memory pages for the season, from who held them first to the sound that made them smile.

What's inside:
• Cover page with name and year
• Your first holiday season: where you were, what they wore, the little details
• A photo page with space to write what happened
• Who we celebrated with: a page for guests to sign
• Our traditions: Christmas, Hanukkah, Diwali, Kwanzaa, Lunar New Year, Eid, New Year's or your own
• Firsts this season: tick, date and one word each
• Gifts received, with a thank-you tick
• A letter to your baby, for when they're old enough to read it
• Handprint and footprint frames
• Next year, we hope: a little time capsule

Good to know:
• 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4, 10 pages each
• A 1-page Start Here guide: printing, paper and gift tips
• Print at home on plain paper or card stock, then fill by hand
• Works with any holiday you celebrate
• A sweet gift for new parents, grandparents and baby showers
• Made with AI assistance, then designed and checked by hand
• Digital download, nothing ships

From Littlefold, a Steadfold studio.
